messages.subject: Re: How to install R, R/qtl and J/qtl?
parts:
The detailed instructions for installing R/qtl are at: http://www.rqtl.org/INSTALL_ME.txt

You first install R:

Windows:
- Go to http://cran.r-project.org/bin/windows/base/
- Click in the top link, "Download R 3.0.1 for Windows"
(Here's the direct link: http://cran.r-project.org/bin/windows/base/R-3.0.1-win.exe)
- This is the usual type of installer for Windows programs. Follow the instructions; you can accept all of the defaults.

Mac:
- Go to http://cran.r-project.org/bin/macosx/
- Download the first file under "Files:", R-3.0.1.pkg
(Here's the direct link: http://cran.r-project.org/bin/macosx/R-3.0.1.pkg)
- This is the usual type of installer for Mac programs. Follow the instructions; you can accept all of the defaults.

I would recommend then installing RStudio, which provides a nice environment for working with R.
- Go to http://www.rstudio.com/ide/download/desktop
- Download the file for your system, which is usually listed at the top of the page.
- Follow the instructions.

To install R/qtl:
- Start R or RStudio.
- Look for the R prompt (a greater-than sign, '>')
- At the prompt, type:
install.packages("qtl")

To install J/qtl, see the instructions at http://churchill.jax.org/software/jqtl/installation.shtml

karl
